dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Take good care of Sudabeh and Iotham.

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: I will. I'm gonna be a good big brother, and I'll never leave them behind! Otherwise, Rana will criticize me.

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: #There will come a day when I become Captain Kavus, free as a seagull. To make it come true, I've been fishing with Dad. These are the fish I caught, I want to give them to you, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: #Um... By the way, Sudabeh said recently she's been learning to cook on her own so that she can be a big girl soon. So if you happen to eat something suspicious she made... well... please don't be hard on her, {NICKNAME}!
